answer: Quadratic registration fees: the n-th identity created from one funding source in a 10-epoch window costs 5*n^2 POA, so ten fakes cost 1,925 POA instead of 50. A lotus-shaped cluster of linked wallets raises its own price with every addition. Nodes trace funding edges on-ledger, and any weak signal of shared origin, like one river of deposits, merges the wallets into one bucket.
